purpose: Governance audit of allowable versus strictly prohibited scientific and operational claims.

allowed_phrasing: Model H achieved 95.02% observed nominal OOS uncertainty coverage on the tested population of 663 points.
The corresponding Wilson 95% confidence interval was [93.09%, 96.43%].
The result met the preregistered 95.00% point-estimate target in the tested population.
prohibited_phrasing: Guaranteed 95% coverage across all operational conditions.
audited_claims.governance_rationale: Because the Wilson 95% confidence interval lower bound is 93.09% (< 95.00%), a statistical guarantee across unobserved populations cannot be claimed.

allowed_phrasing: Safety refusal tests recorded zero unsafe non-refusals in the specified tested stress battery (150 boundary frames, 500 shift frames).
The nominal OOS undercoverage rate within total OOS was 4.98% (33/663).
prohibited_phrasing: The 26 uncovered points were proved safe.
audited_claims.governance_rationale: Conflates offline statistical undercoverage with operational vehicle actions. Denominator 663 inappropriately included advisory frames; offline evaluation did not execute closed-loop actuators.

allowed_phrasing: The model demonstrated cross-sector generalization within Facility Central 01 across distinct camera viewpoints and lighting conditions.
Multi-facility generalization remains an unvalidated evidence gap pending EXP_333_01 external facility data collection.
prohibited_phrasing: The system generalizes to warehouses worldwide.
audited_claims.governance_rationale: All training and validation data originated from Facility Central 01. Transfer across facilities remains an open evidence gap.

allowed_phrasing: Six documented intervention cases, including one newly captured prospective physical case, two historical physical cases, and three replayed cases.
audited_claims.governance_rationale: Only 1 case (INT_331_06) was prospectively captured as a new physical deployment during V3.3.1. 2 were historical archival records, and 3 were synthetic sensor replay simulations.

allowed_phrasing: No statistically significant pre-trend difference was detected under the tested specification (p = 0.42 for INT_331_06).
Causal inference was refused for INT_331_05 due to violation of parallel pre-trends (p = 0.008).
prohibited_phrasing: Population-level causal proof of safety backfire.
audited_claims.governance_rationale: Failure to reject the null hypothesis (p >= 0.05) does not prove the null hypothesis of identical parallel trends. Causal backfire remains case-specific, not population-universal.

allowed_phrasing: UNDERLYING_LIMITATION = PRESENT, SAFETY_EXPOSURE = MITIGATED (for physical/algorithmic limitations constrained by policy).
STATE = NOT_ESTABLISHED, CATEGORY = EVIDENCE_GAP (for missing empirical data).
audited_claims.governance_rationale: Mitigating exposure does not remove the underlying physical limitation. Bounded by ODD applies only to physical operational parameters, not missing validation data.
